profile.headline: Sr Software Engineer at Bank of America
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: Experienced Application Developer with a demonstrated history of working in the financial services industry. Skilled in Analytical Skills, Microsoft Word, Management, Visual Merchandising, and Risk Management. Strong engineering professional with a Master of Arts focused in Mathematics from University at Albany, State University of New York.

positions.title: Vice President - Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
Tech lead on curve marking tool, which is the designated solution used to build curves and set prices for different tradeable assets. 
Building relationships and working directly with trading desk to solve problems
Migrating desk from deprecated spreadsheets to REACT based web apps. This process includes reviewing source data, aiding in controls, and sharing information via central server.
Help traders (market makers) set bid/ask spreads on short term instruments

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
Developing applications to support credit risk pricing and CVA calculations for JPMC’s trading
platforms.
Contributing code to a large scale credit risk engine that utilizes market data and Monte Carlo
simulations to calculate credit risk for JPMC’s entire OTC derivatives portfolio.
Core member of the Methodologies team. A team which is the first point of contact for implementing new requirements from stakeholders.
Partnering with quantitative research to provide cutting edge credit calculation solutions.
Utilizing JPMC’s compute back bone, a large distributed grid which leverages the Symphony
distributed framework to distribute tasks on multiple machines.

positions.title: Business Analyst
positions.description:
Working in a dynamic environment with multiple stakeholders and shareholders to meet tight deadlines and deliver timely results
Providing BA support for firm wide data reference system named taxonomy to meet regulatory requirement for retrieving and storing data electronically
Working with Line of Business leads to analyze documents and rationalize metadata for indexing on capture system
Coordinating with technology partners full cycle of SDLC for reference data system
Managing cross Line of Business support for Subject Matter Experts and Line of Business leads  
Presenting RAG ratings and PM support on highly visible project to senior management

positions.title: Risk Management
positions.description:
Worked on new ALM system RUBY to aggregate financial data and provide dynamic risk metrics 
Performed UAT on new system to validate data and ensure correct results
Created automations and templates to work with new system and provide user accessibility
Reconciled new dynamic risk metrics (Interest Rate Exposure)

positions.title: Mortgage backed Securities Analyst
positions.description:
Developed and programmed an Excel enhancement tool called REX, greatly reducing data mining time
Issued monthly Security reports detailing the performance of the Securitization
Worked with management to outline workflow and structural initiatives to improve time management
Analyzed loss information from banks and investigated loss mitigation compliance recovering in excess of a $100,000 for investors
Created Excel functions to forecast weighted average time for Securitization
